title: LibFlood.calculateSopPerWell div-by-(i-1)=0 reverts flood path in sunrise
description: calculateSopPerWell distributes the flood (Season of Plenty) reduction across positive-deltaB wells. Its final loop runs `for (uint256 i = positiveDeltaBCount; i > 0; i--)` and, inside the branch `if (shaveToLevel > uint256(wellDeltaBs[i-1].deltaB))`, executes `shaveToLevel += (shaveToLevel - uint256(wellDeltaBs[i-1].deltaB)) / (i - 1);`. On the final iteration `i == 1`, so `(i - 1) == 0` and the expression divides by zero, reverting (panic 0x12) whenever that branch is taken for the last (largest, since wells are sorted descending in getWellsByDeltaB) positive well. calculateSopPerWell is called by LibFlood.handleRain, which runs in the flood/Season-of-Plenty branch reached during sunrise (SeasonFacet.gm -> stepSun/weather -> handleRain). When the configuration is mixed-sign (at least one positive and one non-positive well, totalPositiveDeltaB >= totalNegativeDeltaB) and the accumulated shaveToLevel exceeds the largest positive well's deltaB on the final step, the flood computation reverts — and because handleRain executes within the season-advance flow, the revert propagates and blocks that sunrise. Not present in deep-trace; surfaced directly from source.
impact: In a multi-well configuration with mixed-sign deltaBs during a Season of Plenty, the per-well sop allocation can divide by zero and revert. Because the flood logic runs inside the sunrise (gm) call, that revert blocks season advancement for the affected season until the deltaB distribution changes (e.g. reserves shift across a block). Conditional, configuration-dependent temporary DoS of sunrise during flood. Medium under Immunefi v2.2 (season/sunrise DoS, conditional). Currently bounded by the live whitelist having few soppable wells, hence not High.

ice_chain.exploit_path: sunrise during oversaturation -> handleRain -> getWellsByDeltaB (mixed sign) -> calculateSopPerWell -> final i==1 branch divides by 0 -> revert
